description: This file defines a C# class 'ActivationCountBasedPlacementOptions' for configuring activation placement based on counts within Orleans, along with a validator class for its properties.

classes.name: ActivationCountBasedPlacementOptions
classes.description: Contains settings for activating grain placement based on activation count policy, including the number of silos to consider.

methods.name: ActivationCountBasedPlacementOptionsValidator
methods.description: Validates the properties of ActivationCountBasedPlacementOptions to ensure proper configuration.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Checks that the 'ChooseOutOf' property is greater than zero; throws exception if invalid.
